posts.title_en: Internal logic (damage calculation, combat power, etc.)
posts.summary_en: Decompiled formulas (by the leaker 삥삥, marked work in progress) for damage and for the displayed combat power (CP). Per cookie: offense = ATK × (crit dmg × crit rate + 1) × √(accuracy/AA + 1) × √(focus/AA + 1) × (focus% + 1) × (accuracy% + 1) × (element bonus × 0.5 + 1) × (boss dmg × 0.5 + 1); DEF factor = ln(DEF/5,000,000 + 1) + 1; survival = (crit resist + 1) × (HP × DEF factor) × √(evasion/AA + 1) × √(resist/AA + 1) × (resist% + 1) × (evasion% + 1); combined = √( 1/(1 − dmg reduction) × survival × 1/(1 − element reduction × 0.5) × offense ); utility = (speed/speed const + ability haste/1,000,000 + skill amp) × utility coefficient; CP(1 cookie) = floor((utility + 1) × combined × role coefficient); team CP = sum of members' floored CP. Constants: AA (accuracy/avoidance) = 5,000,000, Defense = 5,000,000, AbilityHaste = 1,000,000; role coefficient defense 1.0, charge 1.027, shooter 1.095 (support/heal/speed/utility coefficient included). Guild Conquest recommended power = 10,004,798,560 (about 10G). Team CP ÷ recommended indexes a CP penalty band in the damage formula. Damage = ATK × skill multiplier × 1/(1 + DEF/500) × crit × (1 + skill amp) × element × (1 + boss dmg, vs bosses only) × (1 + final dmg) × (1 − dmg reduction) × CP penalty.

datapoints.note: Because CP is a square root of offense × survival, a +X% to ATK alone (offense) or to HP alone (survival) raises a cookie's CP by about √(1+X) − 1, e.g. ATK +30% → about +14%; crit resist enters survival linearly, which is why 치저 is called a power-padding (뻥투) stat. The √ reading is this extraction's arithmetic on the posted formula.
Guild Conquest recommended power 10,004,798,560 (토벌전 권장전투력, 약 100억).

quotes.en: CP (one cookie) = floor((utility + 1) × combined × role coefficient)
combined = √(1/(1 − damage reduction) × survival × 1/(1 − element reduction × 0.5) × offense)
Guild Conquest recommended power = 10,004,798,560 (about 10G)
